functional_semantics.triton: y = tl.sigmoid(x) in fp32 over N masked elements, stored into a fresh empty_like(X) (impl_triton.py 12-17, 35).
functional_semantics.cutile: y = 1/(1 + ct.exp(-x)) in fp32 over ceil(N/tile) tiles, stored into a fresh empty_like(X) (impl_cutile.py 22-28, 36).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise torch.sigmoid(X) (impl_torch.py 5); the sigmoid builtin versus the explicit exp formula is a primitive choice within tolerance.

stages.triton: One kernel, one launch, grid = ceil(N/block) (38, 42).

precision.triton: Explicit .to(tl.float32) before tl.sigmoid (15-16); implicit downcast at tl.store (17).
precision.cutile: Explicit ct.astype(ct.float32) (23), fp32 exp/add/divide (25), one ct.astype to the output dtype (27).
precision.note: fp32 evaluation with a single downcast on both sides.

preprocessing.triton: torch.empty_like(X) only (35); N trusted for grid and mask (38, 42, 44).
preprocessing.cutile: torch.empty_like(X) only (36); N trusted for the grid (44, 56).
preprocessing.note: Only the output allocation inside run() on both sides; no copy, cast or cached state.

mutation.triton: X read-only; fresh output each call (35).
mutation.cutile: X read-only; fresh output each call (36); tuning launches overwrite output (45), rewritten by the final launch.
mutation.note: No input mutation; idempotent; the contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.note: Single code path on both sides.

fq_boundary.note: n is the case parameter and equals X.numel() (generator tensors.py 111-113 returns (x, n)). Both timed run() bodies allocate the output and launch one kernel that reads n elements once and writes n once, exactly what bytes_expr counts (config.yaml 15). flops_expr is the nominal one-operation-per-element convention.
